name: AE project edit review packet validation schema
purpose: Machine-check a metadata-only review packet before any human approval receipt or manual AE smoke step, without launching AE, executing JSX, reading project payload bytes, or writing project files.

export_artifact_manifest.binding_scope: metadata-only export manifest fields; excludes snapshot JSON and generated JSX bodies directly while covering generated_jsx_artifact_digest fields

report.generated_jsx_artifact_verification_repo: true only when optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification report is supplied
true only when supplied verification report matches the generated JSX transaction report and has verification_status=verified
report.generated_jsx_artifact_verification_stat: copied from optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification report when supplied
report.generated_jsx_artifact_verification_path: copied from optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification report.generated_jsx_path_matches_report when supplied
report.generated_jsx_artifact_verification_byte: copied from optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification report.generated_jsx_bytes_match when supplied
report.generated_jsx_artifact_verification_dige: copied from optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification report.generated_jsx_digest_match when supplied
report.export_artifact_verification_report_chec: true only when optional export artifact verification report is supplied
report.export_artifact_verification_report_veri: true only when supplied verification report matches the export artifact manifest and has verification_status=verified
report.export_artifact_verification_status: copied from optional export artifact verification report when supplied
report.export_artifact_verification_generated_j: copied from optional export artifact verification report.generated_jsx_digest_match when supplied
report.export_artifact_verification_report_side: copied from optional export artifact verification report.report_sidecar_consistent when supplied
report.aepx_preservation_proof_report_checked: true only when optional synthetic preservation proof report is supplied
report.aepx_preservation_proof_ready: true only when supplied proof is synthetic-only, exact-byte-diff verified, privacy-preserving, and production_apply_enabled=false
report.aepx_preservation_proof_production_apply: copied from optional aepx_synthetic_preservation_proof_report.write_gate.production_apply_enabled when supplied; must be false
report.aepx_production_lane_preflight_report_ch: true only when optional AEPX production-lane preflight report is supplied
report.aepx_production_lane_preflight_ready: true only when supplied preflight is apply_gate_closed_ready and all production/binary/write/runtime gates remain false
report.aepx_production_lane_preflight_productio: copied from optional preflight report.production_apply_enabled when supplied; must be false
report.aepx_production_lane_preflight_real_aepx: copied from optional preflight report.real_aepx_input_enabled when supplied; must be false
report.aepx_production_lane_preflight_binary_ae: copied from optional preflight report.binary_aep_writer_enabled when supplied; must be false
copied from optional preflight report.io_gate.binary_aep_read_performed when supplied; must be false
copied from optional preflight report.io_gate.binary_aep_write_performed when supplied; must be false
report.downstream_validate_report_binding_algor: copied from downstream validate report jsx_transaction_report_binding.algorithm
report.generated_jsx_report_binding_algorithm: copied from generated JSX report jsx_transaction_report_binding.algorithm
report.generated_jsx_artifact_digest_algorithm: copied from generated JSX report generated_jsx_artifact_digest.algorithm
report.generated_jsx_artifact_digest_hex: copied from generated JSX report generated_jsx_artifact_digest.digest_hex
report.generated_jsx_embedded_in_report: copied from generated JSX report generated_jsx_artifact_digest.generated_jsx_embedded; must be false

review_packet_binding.checksum_scope: metadata-only review packet binding; excludes request bodies, generated JSX bodies, XML/project payloads, and private patch payloads

cryptographic_digest.digest_scope: metadata-only review packet digest; excludes request bodies, generated JSX bodies, XML/project payloads, and private patch payloads

review_ready_is_not: permission for tools to launch AE
permission to run AEX, OFX, or AviUtl core logic

cli_boundary.usage: ae_project_edit_review_packet --request-pair-manifest request-pair.json --downstream-validate-report validate-report.json --generated-jsx-report generated-report.json [--generated-jsx-artifact-verification-report transaction-artifact-verify.json] [--manual-smoke-closeout-template closeout-template.json] [--export-artifact-manifest export-manifest.json] [--export-artifact-verification-report artifact-verify-report.json] [--aepx-dry-run-report aepx-report.json] [--aepx-preservation-proof-report proof-report.json] [--aepx-production-lane-preflight-report aepx-production-preflight.json] [--report review-packet-report.json]

notes: This review packet is a pre-approval consistency check, not an approval receipt.
A review_ready report still requires a separate approved receipt before any manual AE launch, JSX execution, or project save.
Downstream validate and generated JSX transaction reports must carry metadata-only bindings and sha256-v1 digests before review can pass.
Generated JSX transaction reports must also carry a generated_jsx_artifact_digest with sha256-v1, positive byte count, and generated_jsx_embedded=false before review can pass.

The optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification report can support review only when it proves the local generated JSX path, byte count, and sha256 digest match the generated JSX transaction report; it remains supplemental integrity evidence and must not become approval scope.
The validator must not embed source project payloads, generated JSX bodies, snapshot JSON bodies, private text payloads, media, .ffx data, .aex payloads, or binary .aep data.

The optional export artifact manifest can support review only when its metadata-only checksum/digest recomputes successfully and its generated JSX artifact digest is present; it must remain supplemental metadata and must not become approval scope.

The optional export artifact verification report can support review only when paired with the export artifact manifest, has verification_status=verified, and matches the manifest path, byte count, generated JSX digest, manifest binding, and report sidecar fields; it must remain supplemental metadata and must not become approval scope.

The optional AEPX dry-run report can support review only when its metadata-only binding and sha256-v1 digest are present; it must remain supplemental no-write evidence and must not become permission to apply XML patches.

The optional AEPX synthetic preservation proof can support review only as local-fixture preservation evidence with exact-byte-diff verification and production_apply_enabled=false; it must not become permission to apply production AEPX patches.

The optional AEPX production-lane preflight can support review only as gate-closed evidence; it must remain supplemental metadata and must not become permission to enable AEPX apply, accept real .aepx input, or edit binary .aep files.
AEPX apply, direct binary .aep editing, AEX/OFX loading, and AviUtl core work are out of scope.
